content.text: antidepressants ↑ suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric pts (boxed warning); bupropion (Wellbutrin XL): peds safety and efficacy not established; weigh risks against clinical need; mirtazapine: not established in peds MDD; in an 8-wk peds trial (15–45 mg/day), 49% on mirtazapine gained ≥ 7% body wt vs 5.7% on placebo.
